messages:
mira_sales: Heads-up team — Argentum Financials returned the RFP. They want a capability matrix, our completed security questionnaire, and POC pricing. Theyre targeting a POC next month; procurement wants materials EOD Thu. @jamal_se @lee_security @anita_prod can you triage?

jamal_se: Quick Qs: is the POC embeddings-only or full chat/generation? Also need expected QPS and whether they need on-prem/private for prod or if hosted with VPC peering is acceptable.

mira_sales: They're asking for chat assistant + semantic search (embeddings). Peak target ~80 qps during load tests, dataset ~200GB. Theyre open to hosted for POC with data-residency controls; prod may require private.

anita_prod: For the matrix Ill include rows for two model families: Redwood-3B-quant (cost-optimized) and Redwood-7B-pt (latency/quality). Columns: streaming, tool-calls, embedding dim, max context, KV cache behavior, quantization compatibility, recommended batch. I can draft a CSV today.

sam_infra: For 80 qps with low tail latency we recommend Dedicated or reserved hosted nodes + burst. POC hosted ballpark $12k/week for load tests; Dedicated baseline ~$18k/mo. Private/on-prem needs custom pricing and setup; HSM/KMS adds ops.

lee_security: Security questionnaire note: they asked about SOC2, pen-test cadence, HSM/KMS, VPC peering, audit log retention (1yr vs 7yrs), and customer-managed keys. We have SOC2 attestation. HSM is available for Private but is an add-on. Ill attach a redline and suggested answers.

mira_sales: Can someone post the draft capability matrix and redlined Qs? Ill zip for the RFP portal. Also need a short POC pricing table (hosted vs dedicated vs private) and SOW bullets.

deploy-bot: Uploaded file: https://drive.redwood/example/argentum/capability-matrix-draft.csv

anita_prod: Got the link. Suggest adding a "fallback policy" column and an "expected token cost per 1k conv turns" column. Ill add sample prompts and perf expectations.

jamal_se: Do they require HSM day-1? If yes, POC must be Private or Dedicated + KMS -> longer timeline. If not, hosted with customer-managed cloud KMS is fine.

lee_security: Confirmed: HSM required only for prod. POC can use customer-managed cloud KMS. Draft answer: "BYOK via customer-managed KMS with audit logs; HSM option available for Private deployments."

sam_infra: POC checklist: VPC peering test, dataset upload (S3 presigned), enable prefix caching, load test harness. Jamal, can you paste the runbook snippet?

jamal_se: Runbook snippet: ```1) create project + dataset ACLs
2) upload 200GB to staging S3
3) enable prefix caching
4) route QA traffic via canary (10%)
5) ramp to 80 qps for 30m
6) collect p50/p95/p99 latencies and KV cache hit rate```

mira_sales: Nice. I set procurement expectation: 30-day eval with optional extension. Sam, short hosted vs dedicated blurb?

sam_infra: Hosted (no commit): est $12k/week for the POC profile. Dedicated (1-month reserve): est $18k/mo + SLA. Private/on-prem: custom quote; integration & HSM ~$25k one-time. We can offer 10% discount for 3-6mo pilots.

lee_security: Ive uploaded redlined Q&A and SOC2 summary: https://drive.redwood/example/argentum/security-qna-redline.docx. Also drafting a sensitive-data handling rubric for the POC.

anita_prod: Uploaded v2 of matrix with fallback and token-cost columns: https://drive.redwood/example/argentum/capability-matrix-v2.csv

mira_sales: Action items: jamal -> finalize runbook + scripts; anita -> final CSV + 1-page feature summary; lee -> final redlined questionnaire + SOC2; sam -> pricing blurb and POC cost table. Ill assemble and upload to the RFP portal by Thu EOD. Thanks :thumbsup:

jamal_se: Will push scripts by tomorrow noon.

lee_security: Redline + pentest timeline by Wed.

sam_infra: Sending pricing blurb to Mira via DM now.

mira_sales: Thanks everyone, will ping if procurement needs T&Cs.
